{{Quote|Alternate Historical Simulation A-791PM. Location: Naboo. Viceroy Nute Gunray transmitting. On the grassy plains of Naboo, our battle droid army was frozen at its finest hour. Thousands of warriors stood motionless on the battlefield because of the destruction of an orbital control station. This simulation allows you to control what might have happened if that control station had not been destroyed.|Nute Gunray, to a droid commander|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Alternate Historical Simulation A-791PM''' was a simulation of an alternate outcome to the Battle of the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]], a theatre of the wider [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The simulation was developed to explore the outcome of the battle had the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] not been deactivated by the destruction of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. A droid commander successfully completed the simulation, earning praise from [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]
